title: Photoplethysmography machine learning predicts atrial fibrillation onset hours ahead
summary: A machine learning model was developed on the Huawei Heart Study smart-device photoplethysmography data and optimized in 554 individuals with 469,267 PPG datasets. The primary model's best AUC was 0.94 at 4 hours before AF onset, and the optimized model was prospectively validated in 50 patients with paroxysmal AF against 72-hour Holter monitoring (2,808 AF events), with sensitivity 81.9%, specificity 96.6% and accuracy 88.9% for the 0-4 hour window. The validation cohort is small and the data come from a vendor's devices.
ai_technology: Machine learning model on photoplethysmography signals from smart devices predicting AF onset
organization: Chinese PLA General Hospital; Chinese People's Liberation Army

evidence.tested: Prospective validation of the optimized model in 50 patients with paroxysmal AF, against 72-hour Holter ECG.
evidence.unknown: Performance in larger, less selected populations; benefit of early warning; full text not reviewed.
